description: Step 1 of wallet login. Returns `{ message, timestamp }`: ask the user to sign `message` with their TRON wallet (TronWeb `signMessageV2`, TronLink, etc.), then call `tronsave_login` with `signature: "<signature>_<timestamp>"`. Signing the plain decimal `timestamp` text is also accepted. No auth needed; no side effects on the account.
name: tronsave_get_sign_message

anyOf.description: Hex-encoded nonce message to sign client-side with the user's TRON wallet. The signature must be produced over THIS exact message (case-sensitive).

message.description: Hex-encoded nonce message to sign client-side with the user's TRON wallet. The signature must be produced over THIS exact message (case-sensitive).

anyOf.description: Unix epoch seconds corresponding to `message`. Pair it with the wallet signature in `<signature>_<timestamp>` form when calling `tronsave_login` (signature mode). This endpoint is a convenience helper; clients may provide their own timestamp payload as well.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds corresponding to `message`. Pair it with the wallet signature in `<signature>_<timestamp>` form when calling `tronsave_login` (signature mode). This endpoint is a convenience helper; clients may provide their own timestamp payload as well.

title: Get Signature Message
